{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the total number of rows
total_rows = len(data)

# Confirm the number of unique patient_ids
num_patients = data['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check for any patient_id that might be invalid or sentinel values
# For example, check if any patient_id is 'NA' or 'N/A' or similar
invalid_patient_ids = data['patient_id'].isin(['NA', 'N/A', 'na', 'n/a', '']).sum()

# Check the distribution of patient_id to see if any patterns
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Look for any patient_id with more than one row (duplicates)
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Print results
total_rows, num_patients, invalid_patient_ids, duplicate_patients"}
